title: Pool slot fd cleared on acquire to prevent double-close by concurrent cleanup
description: pool_acquire() clears pool->slots[i].fd = -1 inside the mutex before returning the fd to the caller. This means cleanup() sees -1 and does not close an fd that has already been handed to an active operation. The comment explains this explicitly. A contributor simplifying the pool code might remove the fd=-1 assignment thinking it is redundant. It must be preserved: without it, cleanup() and an active operation holding the fd both call close(fd) — the OS may reuse the fd between the two closes, closing an unrelated fd in the process.
